terra.problem: The passage describes extensive reforms but does not say Josiah cleared out everything that competed with the LORD. That claim overstates what the passage establishes.

Josiah asked about the monument and was told whose tomb it was; the passage does not say he remembered the man of God. Also, ‘clears out what He hasn’t’ suggests that everything God has not expressly said should be removed, rather than focusing on the idolatry Josiah removed.
